summary.en: Geometry reconstruction, occlusion baking, then material/lighting estimation. A staged training baseline.

summary.en: Tracked Gaussians with PBR attributes, material estimation and visibility for dynamic relighting.

summary.en: Hybrid neural shading with FLAME and light-stage capture. Specialized data/model assumptions matter.

summary.en: Transfers trained 2D Gaussian surfels using source/target HDR lighting and normal-dependent irradiance ratios, with separate specular treatment.

summary.en: Decoupled materials/light on 2D Gaussians, driven by simulation/animation deformation; distinct from learning arbitrary video motion.
